featured_reviews.name: Rehan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Wedding Venue Experience – Absolute Mismanagement and Broken Promises

If I could give Sawai Banquet Hall zero stars, I would.

What was supposed to be one of the most important and memorable days of our lives turned into a stressful and frustrating experience because of the venue's complete lack of professionalism, planning, and accountability. The management made countless promises before taking our booking, but when it came time to deliver, they failed on almost every front.

We were explicitly assured that the afternoon event would end by 4:30 PM and that all the venues we had booked Sawai Banquet, Tiara, Ahana, and Vatika  would be fully handed over by 5:30 PM. However, when we arrived at 6:15 PM, the previous event's guests were still vacating the premises. The venue was nowhere close to being ready. Decorations had not been completed, arrangements were unfinished, and there was complete chaos instead of preparation.

The bridal room was another disappointment. The air conditioning was not working, making it extremely uncomfortable for the bride and family members during an already hectic schedule.

The washrooms were dirty, unhygienic, and clearly had not been cleaned properly despite repeated assurances regarding venue cleanliness. For a premium wedding venue, this level of neglect is simply unacceptable.

Several arrangements that were specifically promised during discussions were never provided. Direction boards for the Veg and Non-Veg food sections were missing. The Nikah setup was not arranged as committed. Guests were left confused and inconvenienced due to the lack of basic event coordination.

The situation only worsened during the reception. Even by 8:00 PM, the special reception entry that had been promised was still not ready. Chairs and sofas were covered in dust and looked as though they had not been cleaned before guests arrived. It was embarrassing to host guests under such conditions.

Parking arrangements were another complete failure. We were charged for parking facilities for approximately 30 vehicles and were informed that the venue had a tie-up with Amar Theatre to accommodate additional parking. On the wedding day, we were suddenly informed that the theatre was undergoing demolition and no parking was available. No alternative arrangements were made, leaving our guests to struggle unnecessarily.

What is most disappointing is not just the poor execution, but the complete gap between what was promised and what was delivered. The management seems far more interested in making commitments during the sales process than actually fulfilling them on the event day.

This venue excels at making promises and fails at keeping them.

Our wedding day should have been filled with joy and celebration. Instead, we spent hours dealing with delays, missing arrangements, poor cleanliness, and management failures.

I would strongly advise anyone planning a wedding or major event to avoid Sawai Banquet Hall unless they are prepared for last-minute surprises, broken commitments, and unnecessary stress.

Tall promises. Zero delivery. Zero accountability. Absolutely not recommended.
